Commentary.Commentary: Update 8:55 pm Local (10:55 am GMT) - Bad news, folks! The match has been called off. The rain has not cleared in time for the Aussie batters to walk out. That means each team gets 1 point from this clash. So, the multi-format series stands at 7-5 in favour of Australia Women. India Women would need to win both the T20Is now to win the series. The next T20I will be on 9th October at 6:10 pm Local (8:10 am GMT). Do join us then. Goodbye for now!

Australia Women did not have the best of starts as the Indian openers scored sprightly. It was Ashleigh Gardner who came into the attack and removed both of them in the same over. At one stage India Women were 55-3 and Australia Women were in a very good position but they let it slip in the middle phase and India Women took perfect advantage of it. Ashleigh Gardner was the pick of the bowlers as she took 2 wickets while Georgia Wareham and Sophie Molineux took a wicket each. Meg Lanning used as many as 8 bowlers but not everyone found success. Now, it will be interesting to see what the target will be for the hosts, how many overs they get and more importantly if we get any more action at all. Stay with us to find out. We will bring you updates as and when we get them.

What an unfortunate end to India Women's innings. They had a good platform and would have wanted to accelerate in the last few overs. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma started well at the top and gave them a great start. But they fell in the same over and Harmanpreet Kaur too fell early. But Jemimah Rodrigues held the innings together and expressed herself really well with the bat. She was well supported by Yastika Bhatia for a while before she fell. Richa Ghosh and Jemimah Rodrigues were batting really well and they would have wanted to tee off in the last few overs but the rain gods had different plans.

Update 8:27 pm Local (10:27 am GMT) - Well, we have some official news for you. It has now been decided that India Women's innings has been done and Australia Women would walk to bat if and when the game resumes. A reminder that play needs to start by 9:06 pm Local for there to be at least a 5-over game.
Update 8:05 pm Local (10:05 am GMT) - The drizzle continues but it is not very heavy at the moment. The players are still waiting at the sidelines in the hope of a swift resumption.

Update 7:49 pm Local (9:49 am GMT) - The rain has arrived here at the Carrara Oval and the umpires have asked the players to walk back. The rain has got even heavier and the covers are out on the pitch. Stay tuned for further updates. This may not be a long delay as the rain seems to have eased out a bit.

Loopy ball, on off. Pushed to deep cover for one.
Full and on middle, flicked to the left of mid-wicket who does well to dive to that side and stop it. One.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Jemimah Rodrigues misses her flick.
Short in length, on the pads, Jemimah Rodrigues tucks it to fine leg for a couple.
Short and on middle, whacked to deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length, on middle. Richa Ghosh looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short and on middle, pulled over mid on for a couple of runs.
Length and on middle, this one skids through. Jemimah looks to play on the leg side and ends up hitting it to third man for a single.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS! Full and on middle. Richa Ghosh again goes for the big drive but gets an outside edge past short third man and to the fence.
Full and outside off, guided to third man for a single.
On the pads, worked to the fine leg region for one.
FOUR! Just over! Full and outside off. Ghosh looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge over short third man for a boundary.
Around off, kept out.
FOUR! Full and on middle. Richa Ghosh flicks it uppishly towards wide long on where the fielder charges in but the ball drops short of her and rolls behind to the fence.
Tahlia McGrath comes in the attack.
Flatter and on off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
DROPPED! Short and outside off. Richa Ghosh looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge to the keeper who spills it out.
Flatter and on off. Richa Ghosh looks to push but does it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, nudged on the leg side for a single.
Richa Ghosh is the next batter.
OUT! TAKEN! Georgia Wareham strikes on her very first ball! Full and on middle. Bhatia slogs it without much power towards long on where Vlaeminck takes a good low catch.

Commentary.Commentary: Georgia Wareham comes in the attack.
On a length, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to covers. There is a slight mix-up but Yastika Bhatia makes her ground in time.
A length ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues shuffles across and misses her cut.
FOUR! Well played! Full and outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues steers it past the diving short third man fielder for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Yastika Bhatia hits it over square leg for a single.
Around off, on a length, pushed to covers for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! A length ball, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues makes room and cuts it hard past short third man for a boundary. She is looking in good touch.
Nicola Carey is back on. She went for 7 runs in her first over.
Flatter and outside off, guided to backward point for a single.
FOUR! Timing! Full and outside off. Bhatia gets across and paddles it fine past short fine leg for a boundary.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! A short ball, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues hits it past short third man for a boundary.

CHANCE! On middle. Yastika Bhatia looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball lobs to the left side of the pitch and Bhatia is halfway down for a single, Jemimah yells no. The keeper has a chance at her side as Bhatia slips but still, she misses her shy. A single taken.
Flatter and on off. Jemimah skips down and punches it to mid off for a quick single.
Full ball, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to long off for one.
Just a single as this is pushed to long on.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Hammered again! Length ball, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues slashes it over covers for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Smacked! Length ball, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues hits it over mid off for a boundary.
Change. Hannah Darlington is into the attack.
On a length, outside off. Bhatia goes for the drive but misses.
Full ball, on the pads. Jemimah Rodrigues flicks it past mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Cut away to point.
Length ball, on off. Punched to long on for one.
FOUR! Length ball, on off. Bhatia hits it over covers. The fielder chases it but in vain.
Shorter ball, outside off. Played to third man for one.
Length ball, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues works it to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Smashed! Short ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it hard to the point fence.
Short ball, on off. Pulled to mid-wicket for one.
Short ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it away. The fielder at point dives and keeps it to one.
Darted on the pads. Tucked to mid-wicket for one.
Flatter ball, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues runs it to third man for one.
Ashleigh Gardner is back on.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out.
Short of a length, outside off. Bhatia misses the cut.
Short ball, on leg. Jemimah Rodrigues goes for the pull but gets the top edge to third man for one.
Length ball, on off. Bhatia pushes it past covers for one.
Short of a length, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues goes for the pull but gets it to third man for one.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to mid on.
Flatter ball, on off. Bhatia looks to cut but gets hit on the pads. The LBW appeal is turned down.
Change. Ellyse Perry is into the attack.
Yastika Bhatia walks out.
OUT! LBW! Sophie Molineux gets revenge! Tossed up, on off. Kaur looks to block and gets hit on the pads. The appeal is put in and umpire raises the finger!
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up, on leg. Kaur sweeps it past the diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed past covers for one.
Darted on the pads. Blocked out.
FOUR! Top shot! Flatter ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A full ball, on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur leans and flicks it wide of deep square leg and the ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur is off the mark! Short and on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to square leg for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single.
Length ball, on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
That was quick! On a length, outside off, it lands and straightens up off the deck. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to play inside the line but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, outside off, shaping away. Jemimah Rodrigues shoulders arms to it.
Full and on middle. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it out.
Harmanpreet Kaur is the next batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Both the openers are back in the pavilion in the same over! It was the same length as the previous delivery. Shafali Verma this time hits it flat and straight to deep mid-wicket where Georgia Wareham holds onto it.
Commentary.Howout: c Georgia Wareham b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Verma toying with the Aussie bowlers! A flatter ball, outside off. Verma gets low and clobbers it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
On middle, worked on the leg side.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! The in-form Mandhana has been sent back to the hut. This is full and on off. Mandhana comes down the track but fails to reach the pitch of the ball. She toe-ends it high up in the air and towards mid on where Hannah Darlington takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Hannah Darlington b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on off. Mandhana steers it down the ground past short third man for a couple of runs.
Change. Ashleigh Gardner comes in the attack.
Short in length and on middle. Shafali Verma makes room and looks to cut but fails to connect. The ball rolls over the middle stump to the keeper.
SIX! HAMMERED! Full and on leg. Shafali Verma makes room and thumps it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
The idea is right but Verma is failing to execute! Full and outside off. Shafali Verma shuffles across and looks to whip but misses again.
Short of a length, outside off. Verma backs away and drags it to mid on.
Around off, pushed to covers.
WIDE! Tayla Vlaeminck sees Verma again step across and go for the paddle. Tayla Vlaeminck bowls it short and down the leg side.
On a length, outside off. Shafali Verma shuffles way across on the off side and looks to paddle but misses.
FOUR! 14 off the over! On a length, on middle. Smriti Mandhana paddles it through square leg for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Mandhana on the charge. This is full and on off. Mandhana goes inside-out as she lifts this over mid off for a maximum.
Flatter and on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and on the pads, nudged to square leg.
FOUR! Good shot! Tossed up, on middle. Mandhana skips down and lofts it over mid on and the ball races away to the fence.
Who will start from the other end? Sophie Molineux it is.
Short of a length, on middle. Verma blocks it out on the leg side.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Now serves a short ball, on middle. Verma looks to pull but misses.
This is on a length, outside off. Verma makes room and looks to slap but fails to get any bat on it.
SIX! What a way to get off the mark! On a length, outside off. Verma makes room and hammers it over covers for a biggie.
On a length, on middle and leg, flicked to fine leg for a single. Just a single from the Free Hit.
NO BALL! Not a good start from Tayla Vlaeminck. This is short and outside off. Mandhana looks to chase it but misses. Free Hit coming up as Tayla Vlaeminck has overstepped.
We are set for the clash! The players stride out to the middle. The Aussies have taken their positions. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma walk out to bat. Tayla Vlaeminck to start with the ball.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Yastika Bhatia, Richa Ghosh (WK), Pooja Vastrakar, Deepti Sharma, Shikha Pandey, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, Nicola Carey, Sophie Molineux, Georgia Wareham, Hannah Darlington, Tayla Vlaeminck.
Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says that it is good to be back and informs that they have two debutants today, Yastika Bhatia and Renuka Singh.
Meg Lanning, the skipper of Australia Women, says that it is a fresh wicket. Informs that Tahlia McGrath and Hannah Darlington will make their debut in this game.
TOSS - Australia Women have won the toss and they have elected to bowl first.

A reminder that in this multi-format series, a points-based system is being used. The Test match accounted for 4 points and each limited-overs match will carry 2 points. Australia Women won the ODI series 2-1 and the Test was drawn. So, the points currently are 6 for Australia Women and India Women have 4 points. That means, if the tourists are to win the multi-format series, they would need to inflict a clean sweep in this T20I series.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the first T20I between India Women and Australia Women. A T20I series between these two teams means plenty of exciting cricketing action headed our way and that was evident during the 2020 T20 World Cup which was won by the Aussies. What will this series bring? We will find out. Stay tuned for toss and more updates.
